overview: K-map se minimal SOP/POS, don't cares, prime implicants, literal count.
coreConcept: Adjacent 1s ke groups (power of 2 size) banao; bada group = kam literals.
hinglishExplanation: K-map me wrap-around adjacency hoti hai. Har group ek term deta hai: group me jo variables change hote hain wo hat jaate hain. Don't cares 1 maan sakte ho agar group bada hota ho. POS ke liye 0s group karo.
formalDefinition: Adjacent 1s ke groups (power of 2 size) banao; bada group = kam literals.
importantProperties: Don't care sirf grouping me madad ke liye.
POS: 0s ko group karo aur complement lo.
Literal count = sum of literals in minimal expression.
Minimal SOP unique nahi hota hamesha.
